import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INV = 570000004;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> indexMap = new HashMap<>();
    static int totalNodes, timeStamp;
    static int[][] child;
    static int[][] p = new int[7][7];
    static int[][] q = new int[7][128];
    static int[][] dp = new int[8][65536];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        totalNodes = 0;
        child = new int[65536][1 << n];

        // Function dfs and auxiliary method
        class Helper {
            int dfs(BitSet state) {
                if (indexMap.containsKey(state))
                    return indexMap.get(state);
                int id = timeStamp++;
                indexMap.put((BitSet) state.clone(), id);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << totalNodes); ++mask) {
                    BitSet newState = (BitSet) state.clone();
                    for (int j = 0; j < (1 << totalNodes); ++j) {
                        if (!newState.get(j)) {
                            int kMask = mask & j;
                            while (kMask != 0) {
                                int k = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(kMask);
                                if (state.get(j ^ (1 << k))) {
                                    newState.set(j);
                                    break;
                                }
                                kMask &= ~(1 << k);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    child[id][mask] = dfs(newState);
                }
                return id;
            }
        }

        Helper helper = new Helper();

        // Read p matrix
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine().trim());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                p[i][j] = mulMod(p[i][j], INV);
            }
        }

        // Initialize state
        BitSet initialState = new BitSet();
        initialState.set(0);
        int startId = helper.dfs(initialState);
        totalNodes = startId + 1; // approximate for size
        // For safe measure, assigning an upper bound
        totalNodes = Math.max(totalNodes, 1);

        // Compute q arrays
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    int val = ((j >> k) & 1) == 1 ? p[k][i] : subMod(1, p[k][i]);
                    q[i][j] = mulMod(q[i][j], val);
                }
            }
        }

        // Dynamic programming
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < totalNodes; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); k++) {
                    int next_state = child[j][k];
                    dp[i + 1][next_state] = addMod(dp[i + 1][next_state], mulMod(dp[i][j], q[i][k]));
                }
            }
        }

        // Final state
        BitSet result = new BitSet();
        result.set(0, (1 << n));
        int index = indexMap.getOrDefault(result, -1);
        System.out.println(dp[n][index]);
    }

    static int addMod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a + b;
        return s >= MOD ? s - MOD : s;
    }

    static int subMod(int a, int b) {
        int s = a - b;
        return s < 0 ? s + MOD : s;
    }

    static int mulMod(int a, int b) {
        return (int)((1L * a * b) % MOD);
    }
}
